definitions: The top part of a hill or mountain.
A plume of feathers or other decoration, especially on a helmet.
A decorative design or symbol, often used as an emblem of a family, school, or organization.
The highest point of a wave.
examples: They reached the crests of the mountains.
The knights wore elaborate crests on their helmets.
The school's crests were embroidered on the blazers.
The boat rode over the crests of the waves.
